All cycles complete. Here's a summary of what was built:

**New packages:**
- `hasher/hasher.go` — `Hasher` interface (`Hash`, `Verify`)
- `hasher/fakes/hasher.go` — `FakeHasher` (transparent: `"hashed:" + password`)
- `hasher/fakes/hasher_test.go` — contract test against the fake
- `hasher/contract/hasher.go` — `RunHasherContract` (5 cases)
- `hasher/sha256/hasher.go` — `SHA256Hasher` using `crypto/sha256` + `encoding/hex`
- `hasher/sha256/hasher_test.go` — contract test against the real implementation

**Extended:**
- `domain/user.go` — `passwordHash` field, `NewUserWithPassword`, `RehydrateUserWithPassword`, `PasswordHash()` accessor
- `repository/fakes/user.go` — `FakeUserRepository` preserves password hash; `SetSaveError` for error-path testing
- `repository/memstore/user.go` — `userRecord` persists `password_hash`; both `Save` and `GetByEmail` round-trip the field
- `repository/contract/user.go` — new contract case: "preserves password hash on save and retrieve"
- `service/access.go` — `ErrInvalidCredentials`, `Register`, `Login`; `NewAccessService` now accepts a `Hasher`
- `service/access_test.go` — 6 new tests covering `Register` (no-error, hashed-storage, save-error propagation) and `Login` (happy path, unknown email, wrong password)
